segments.speaker: S1
segments.text: Hello Ramesh, this is Asha from Ghamghar Solar. You sent an inquiry through our website, is that right?

segments.speaker: S2
segments.text: Yes, I wanted to ask about a solar system for my home. My monthly electricity bill is high.

segments.speaker: S1
segments.text: I understand. Our 3 kW grid-tie system costs NPR 4,20,000 including installation.

segments.speaker: S2
segments.text: That is a little expensive. Another company quoted NPR 3,60,000.

segments.speaker: S1
segments.text: Our panels have a 25-year performance warranty, and the inverter also has a 10-year warranty.

segments.speaker: S1
segments.text: EMI is available through a partner bank. I'll email you the details.

segments.speaker: S2
segments.text: How long does the net metering process take?

segments.speaker: S1
segments.text: NEA approval normally takes two weeks.

segments.speaker: S2
segments.text: All right. Please email me a detailed quotation.

segments.speaker: S1
segments.text: Sure, I'll email you the quotation and EMI details by tomorrow evening.

segments.speaker: S2
segments.text: When will you come for the site visit?

segments.speaker: S1
segments.text: Sometime next week we'll send our engineer for a site visit. I'll call later to confirm the day.

segments.speaker: S2
segments.text: Okay, I'll discuss it at home and call back on Friday.

segments.speaker: S1
segments.text: Thank you, Ramesh. I'll email you tomorrow.
